title: C.C. Alavi Haji v. Palapetty Muhammed

content.caseIdentity: C.C. Alavi Haji v. Palapetty Muhammed, (2007) 6 SCC 555
content.holding: Deemed service of notice under Section 27 General Clauses Act applies when notice is correctly addressed and sent by registered post. A drawer claiming non-receipt must pay within 15 days of court summons to avert prosecution.
content.relevance: Presumption of service of statutory notice and protection against evasive drawers.
